# UNICON LEATHER — Global Leather Goods Manufacturer & Export Atelier

> UNICON LEATHER (Unicon Leather Goods Export Private Limited) is a premier Indian OEM/ODM private-label leather goods manufacturer and registered export house. Founded with master atelier facilities at Calcutta Leather Complex (CLC), Bantala, Kolkata, and corporate headquarters in Noida (Delhi NCR), India.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** Unicon Leather Goods Export Private Limited
- **Official Website:** https://www.uniconleather.com/
- **Business Type:** B2B Contract Manufacturer, OEM/ODM Atelier, Wholesale Exporter
- **Corporate HQ:** Office No. 11, 4th Floor, Indian Green Centre, 58, Bhangel, Sector - 106, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201304, India
- **Factory Facility:** Plot 676, 687, 944, 1084, Zone 09, Bantala, Kolkata Leather Complex, Kolkata, West Bengal 743502, India
- **WhatsApp Desk:** +91 9873102341
- **Export Inquiries:** uniconexport@gmail.com / work@uniconleather.net

## Core Capabilities & Services
- **Custom Leather Handbag Manufacturing:** Luxury satchels, structured shoulder bags, hobos, and evening clutches.
- **Leather Tote Bags Wholesale:** Feather-edge turned totes, architectural winged shoppers, and jacquard-leather hybrid carryalls.
- **Executive Laptop & Business Bags:** Double-gusset briefcases, slim leather folios, and commuter messenger bags.
- **Travel Luggage & Duffels:** Waxed pull-up leather weekender bags, framed doctor's bags, and rolling duffels.
- **Small Leather Goods (SLG):** RFID-shielded bifold and trifold wallets, cardholders, passport covers, money clips, and key pouches.
- **Leather Outerwear & Belts:** Tailored lambskin jackets, hand-burnished bridle leather belts, and custom hardware buckles.

## International Trade Corridors & Compliance
- **United States & North America (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-us):** California Proposition 65 SGS lab compliant (lead-free, cadmium-free, phthalate-safe), CPSIA verified, ASTM tested, direct DDP shipping to US distribution centers.
- **Canada (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-ca):** CCPSA compliant, cold-resistant drum-dyed full-grain leathers, CBSA customs cleared, direct DDP shipping to Toronto, Montreal, and Vancouver.
- **United Kingdom & Ireland (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-gb):** UK/EU REACH Annex XVII chemical safety batch-testable, SEDEX SMETA / BSCI open-factory audit readiness, CIF London Gateway / Southampton and DDP UK delivery.
- **Australia & New Zealand (https://www.uniconleather.com/en-au):** India-Australia ECTA 0% Preferential Import Duty with official Certificate of Origin (COO), Australian DAFF biosecurity import verified.
- **Germany & DACH Region (https://www.uniconleather.com/de):** DIN EN ISO norms, REACH Annex XVII batch-testable, hides sourced from LWG Gold/Silver audited partner tanneries, DDP Frankfurt / Hamburg.
- **France & Europe (https://www.uniconleather.com/fr):** Haute Maroquinerie craftsmanship, hand-painted and polished edge lacquer, REACH verified, DDP Paris / Le Havre.
- **Italy & Southern Europe (https://www.uniconleather.com/it):** Pelletteria artigianale standards, 0.4mm Fortuna skiving, multi-coat Fenice edge inking, EU REACH & EUDR traceable hides, DDP Milan / Genoa.
- **Spain & Iberia (https://www.uniconleather.com/es):** Marroquinería OEM/ODM, EU REACH Annex XVII compliant, DDP Barcelona / Valencia / Madrid.
- **Netherlands & Benelux (https://www.uniconleather.com/nl):** EU REACH compliant, LWG partner tannery hides, DDP Port of Rotterdam & Amsterdam Schiphol.
- **Sweden & Nordics (https://www.uniconleather.com/sv):** Vegetable-tanned & chrome-free hides, EU REACH chemical safety, DDP Gothenburg & Stockholm Arlanda.
- **UAE, Saudi Arabia & GCC (https://www.uniconleather.com/ar):** 0% UAE Customs Duty under India-UAE CEPA, 100% bovine/ovine halal-compliant hides, 24K PVD gold hardware, DDP Dubai / Abu Dhabi / Riyadh.
- **Japan (https://www.uniconleather.com/ja):** India-Japan CEPA preferential duty, AQL 2.5 & needle-detection (検針) inspection, YKK Excella hardware, DDP Tokyo / Narita / Yokohama.
- **South Korea (https://www.uniconleather.com/ko):** Korea-India CEPA preferential Certificate of Origin, 0.4mm skiving & edge-coat finishing, DDP Incheon & Port of Busan.

## Sourcing Specifications & SLAs
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ):** 50 pieces per style for Stock-Leather Trial Runs (bags/jackets) and 100 pieces for wallets/belts; 100–200 pieces per style for Custom Drum-Dyed Leather runs.
- **Prototype / Counter-Sample Turnaround:** 5 to 7 business days (wallets/belts) and 7 to 14 business days (bags/jackets) in stock leather via DHL / FedEx Express; +7 to 10 additional business days (14–21 days total) when custom Pantone drum-dyed hides or custom 3D CNC brass hardware molds are required.
- **Bulk Production Lead Time:** 25 to 40 business days upon Pre-Production Sample (PPS) approval (20 to 30 business days for repeat orders).
- **Leather Tannages Sourced:** Full-grain bovine, Tuscan-style vegetable-tanned, Nappa calfskin, pebble grain, lambskin nappa, goat suede, and crazy horse pull-up.
- **Supply Chain vs. Factory Credentials:** Unicon Leather is a cut-and-sew manufacturer and registered Indian export house; raw hides are procured from Leather Working Group (LWG) audited partner tanneries, and chemical compliance (EU/UK REACH Annex XVII & US California Prop 65) is verified via batch-specific accredited laboratory testing (SGS / Intertek / TÜV).
- **Quality Control Protocol:** 4-stage internal QC with final ISO 2859-1 (AQL 2.5 Major / 4.0 Minor) pre-shipment audit reports; open to third-party inspections (QIMA / SGS / Bureau Veritas).
- **Fast-Track Sample Development SLA:**
  1. [Tech Pack Received] Intake under bilateral NDA protection.
  2. (24–48 Hours) [Engineering Feasibility & BOM Cost Review] Pattern & hide yield assessment.
  3. [Factory Quotation (FOB/CIF/DDP) & Lead Times Provided] Tiered wholesale price breakdown.
  4. (Upon Approval) [Physical Sample Development & Dispatch: 5–7 Days (SLGs) / 7–14 Days (Bags/Jackets) in stock leather; +7–10 Days for custom dye/tooling].
- **Supported Incoterms:** Ex-Works (EXW), FOB Kolkata / Chennai / Nhava Sheva, CIF, and DDP door-to-door.

## Indian Manufacturing Clusters & Asian Sourcing Advantages
- **Strategic Atelier Locations:** Primary master atelier located at Calcutta Leather Complex (CLC), Bantala, Kolkata, West Bengal with northern coordination in Noida / Delhi NCR. Positioned among India's foremost leather clusters alongside Kanpur, Chennai, Ranipet/Ambur, and Agra.
- **Asian Sourcing Comparisons (India vs. China, Vietnam, Bangladesh):** Unicon Leather delivers an optimal balance of low MOQs (from 50–100 units), artisan hand-finishing, direct LWG Gold/Silver partner tannery raw hide access, SEDEX/BSCI open-factory audit readiness, and EU REACH compliance without the high MOQs common in mass assembly factories.
- **Full-Spectrum Contract Capabilities:** Genuine leather handbags, structured totes, executive laptop briefcases, travel duffels, backpacks, custom leather jackets, RFID wallets, cardholders, bridle belts, and corporate leather gifts.
